checkingBody: One moment while your session and role are confirmed.
sessionExpired: Your session ended because it expired. Sign in again to continue.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Use the account the Municipality created for you.
signIn.noSelfSignup: Staff accounts are created by the Coordinator. There is no public sign-up.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: We will email you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If that address has an account, a reset link is on its way. Check your inbox and your spam folder.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a password you have not used on this system before.
reset.linkInvalid: This reset link is no longer valid. Request a new one from the sign-in screen.

errors.bothRequired: Enter both your email address and your password.
errors.invalidCredentials: That email address and password do not match an account.
errors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
errors.resetFailed: That password could not be saved. Request a new reset link and try again.

noRole.title: Your account has no role yet
noRole.subtitle: Signed in as {email}.

notLinked.title: Your account is not linked to a producer record yet
notLinked.subtitle: Signed in as {email}.
notLinked.body: The Municipality creates the producer record and links it to your account. Until that is done there are no registrations to show. Contact the Coordinator if you think this is a mistake.

denied.title: Not available for your role
denied.body: Your account does not have access to this screen. If you need it, ask the Coordinator to change your role.
denied.moduleBody: Your account does not have access to this form. If you need it, ask the Coordinator to change your role.
